title: 第9章 锁住第10章 亵渎裁决之魂
lines: 冰冷刺骨的感觉无休止地侵蚀着卡拉斯残破的身体。
他靠在潮湿的岩壁上，每一次呼吸都带着胸腔深处的杂音和冰碴摩擦的痛楚。
意识在剧痛与昏沉间摇摆，如同风中残烛。
唯一的光源来自悬浮在暗爪上方的深蓝龙晶。
格罗兹的生命核心缓缓旋转，散发出柔和却刺骨的幽蓝光芒。
精纯的冰冷能量如涓涓细流，注入暗爪残破的身躯。
幽蓝能量在撕裂的翼膜、翻卷的皮肉和碎裂的鳞甲间穿梭弥合。
黯淡的星尘纹路重新闪烁起微弱却顽强的幽绿光芒。
暗爪那几乎断绝的气息，在这来自宿敌的生命馈赠下缓慢而坚定地恢复。
卡拉斯透过模糊的视线看着这幽蓝与幽绿交织的景象。
杀戮，吞噬，生存。
这钢铁般的律令连暗爪这头“造物”
也无法逃脱。
一丝龙晶能量流向卡拉斯肋下狰狞的伤口。
他本能地绷紧身体，排斥这来自蓝龙的冰冷意志。
但能量流带着纯粹的生命修复力，轻柔覆盖在翻卷的皮肉上。
极致冰冷瞬间渗透！
这冰冷反而压制了持续不断的灼痛和星尘能量的刺痛！
一种奇异的麻木感混合着微弱生机注入他枯竭的肢体。
断裂的骨头在冰冷能量包裹下传来酸胀的钝痛，至少不再完全散架。
失血带来的眩晕被驱散一线。
这来自宿敌的“馈赠”
，带着冰冷的讽刺，维系着他最后的生机。
黑暗之后的声音在灵魂深处幽幽响起：
“生与死…吞噬与馈赠…此乃…吾之循环…”
声音中带着掌控万物的漠然。
时间在冰冷能量流淌中流逝。
卡拉斯在剧痛间隙积攒着力气。
他不能在这里等死。
格罗兹的死亡和亵渎之炉的崩塌只能暂时阻隔追兵。
他必须带着暗爪离开。
他挣扎着用刚刚恢复知觉的手臂支撑岩壁，缓慢挪动。
每一次动作都带来撕裂般的痛楚。
他艰难挪到暗爪身边。
幼龙体型已接近大型猎犬，气息平稳许多。
覆盖冰冷鳞片的身躯上，致命伤口已弥合大半，只留下纵横交错的深暗疤痕。
碎裂的鳞片重新生长，边缘闪烁幽暗寒光。
星尘翅膀收拢在身侧，破损的翼膜被坚韧的新生组织覆盖。
它熔金的竖瞳紧闭，胸膛平稳起伏，陷入深度修复性沉睡。
悬浮的龙晶光芒黯淡许多，体积缩小近半，旋转极其缓慢。
卡拉斯颤抖的手小心翼翼搭在暗爪冰冷的脊背上。
指尖传来更加坚韧冰冷的触感和微弱平稳的心跳。
他心中稍安。
content_en:
The biting cold feeling eroded Karas' broken body endlessly.
He leaned against the wet rock wall, and every breath he took brought with it the murmur deep in his chest and the pain of friction against the ice.
Consciousness swayed between severe pain and drowsiness, like a candle in the wind.
The only light source comes from the dark blue dragon crystal suspended above the Dark Claw.
Groz's life core slowly rotated, emitting a soft but biting blue light.
Pure cold energy poured into Dark Claw's broken body like a trickle.
The blue energy shuttled between the torn wing membranes, rolled flesh and broken scales.
The dim stardust lines once again shone with a weak but tenacious green light.
Dark Claw's almost extinct aura slowly but surely recovered under the gift of life from its old enemy.
Karas looked at this scene of intertwined blue and green through blurred vision.
Kill, devour, survive.
This steely law even connects the "creature" Darkclaw
There is no way to escape either.
A trace of dragon crystal energy flowed towards the hideous wound under Karas's ribs.
He instinctively tensed up his body, rejecting the cold will coming from the blue dragon.
But the energy flow carries pure life-restoring power, gently covering the rolled flesh.
"Uh..."
The ultimate coldness penetrates instantly!
This coldness suppressed the constant burning pain and the sting of stardust energy!
A strange numbness mixed with a faint sense of life poured into his withered limbs.
The broken bones felt a dull pain of soreness and swelling under the cold energy, at least they were no longer completely falling apart.
The dizziness caused by blood loss was dispelled.
This is a "gift" from an old enemy
, with cold irony, maintained his last vitality.
The voice behind the darkness sounded faintly in the depths of the soul:
"Life and death...devourment and gift...this is...my cycle..."
There was a controlled indifference in his voice.
Time passes in the flow of cold energy.
Karas gathered strength between bouts of pain.
He can't wait to die here.
Groz's death and the collapse of the Forge of Profanity could only temporarily stymie the pursuers.
He must leave with Darkclaw.
He struggled to support the rock wall with his arms that had just regained consciousness and moved slowly.
Every movement brought tearing pain.
He moved with difficulty to Darkclaw's side.
The size of the young dragon is close to that of a large hunting dog, and its breath is much calmer.
On the body covered with cold scales, most of the fatal wounds have been healed, leaving only criss-crossing dark scars.
The broken scales grew again, and the edges shone with a dark and cold light.
Stardust's wings were folded at his side, and the damaged wing membranes were covered with tough new tissue.
Its molten gold vertical pupils were tightly closed, its chest rose and fell steadily, and it fell into a deep restorative sleep.
The suspended dragon crystal's light is much dimmed, its size is reduced by nearly half, and its rotation is extremely slow.
Karas' trembling hand carefully placed on Darkpaw's cold back.
A tougher, colder touch and a weak, steady heartbeat came from my fingertips.
He felt a little at ease.
